content: Babiloone Kundethaa
Yaatidi, gita maati de7iya hara kiitanchoy salope wodhishin ta be7as. He kiitanchuwa bonchoy sa7a poo7isis.
He kiitanchoy ba qaala dhoqu oothidi,

content.text: Babilooney tuna ayyaanati aqiya bessi gidasu.
tuna kafotinne do7ati shempiya bessi gidasu.
Asa koche ubbaa ba laymatetha woyniya ushshasu.

content: yaagis.
Hessafe guye, ta salope haysada giya hara qaala si7as.

content.text: iya ekanaw de7iya seera hinte ekonna mela,
Hiza, I nagaray salo gakanaw dooretis.
Iya immidaysa mela zaaridi iw immite.
Iya oothida oosuwas nam7u kushe iw zaarite.
Iya giigisida ushsha bolla hinte nam7u kushe mathoyiya ushsha I xuu7an kunthite.
Iya baw bonchetidaysadanne iw injetidaysa mela,
‘Taani kaweeda uttas; ta azini bayna maccas gidike;
hargey, kayoynne koshi iyo issi gallas oykana.
ayis giiko, I bolla pirdiya Xoossay wolqaama”

content: yaagis.
“Iira laymatidaysatinne I miikotethan de7ida, alamiya kawoti he katamiya xuugetin keyiya cuyaa be7ida wode iw waassidi yeekana.
Enti he katame waayiya be7idi yayyida gisho, haaki eqidi,

content.text: Neeni issi saate giddon ne pirda ekadasa’ yaagana.

content: “Enta markabiya caana hizape shammiya asi bayna gisho, sa7an de7iya zal7anchoti he katamaas waassananne kayotana.
Enta worqa, bira, boncho shuchu, al7o shucha, kaalose ma7o, liino ma7o, haare ma7o, zo7o ma7o, dumma dumma sawo mithi, dangarsa zaale, al7o mithi, naase birata, goole shuchu,
qarafa, qimame, ixaane, karbe, shitto, woyne, zayte, lo77o dhiille, giste, mehe, dorse, para, para gaare, aylletanne hara asata shammiya oonika baawa.
“Zal7anchoti maccaseeko, ‘Neeni amotida lo77oba ubbay neepe dhayis. Ne aqoynne alleeqetidaba ubbay neepe haakis. Neeni zaarada enta ubbaa demmaka’ yaagidosona.
He kataman zal7idi duretida zal7anchoti I metuwa babidi iipe haakidi eqana. Enti yeekananne kayotana.
Qassi,

content.text: worqan, boncho shuchaninne inqo geetetiya al7o shuchan alleeqetida,
Haysa mela gita shalo ubbay issi saate giddon dhayis’ yaagidosona.

content: “Markabiya laagiya ubbay, markabiyan biya ubbay, markabiya bolla oothiya ubbaynne abban zal7iya ubbay haaki eqidosona.
He katamiya xuugetin keyiya cuyaa be7ida wode, ‘Ha gita katamiw daaniya hara katami de7ishsha?’ yaagidosona.
Enti banta huuphen baana qolidi, waassidosonanne kayotidosona.

content.text: he katamiya issi saaten dhayida gisho,
Xoossay hinte gisho I bolla pirdida gisho ufaytite’ yaagidosona.”

content: Yaatin, mino kiitanchoy woxa daaniya gita shuchu denthidi abban holishe, “Gita katamiya Babilooney wolqan holettada haysada kundana; iya hachife guye ubbaka bentuku.
Diithi diixeysatinne yexeysati, suusul7enne moyze punneysati, hizape guye ne giddon ubbaka si7etokona. Ay kocha zal7e zal7iya asika ne giddon bentenna. Woxa girsi hizape guye ne giddon si7etenna.

Xompe poo7oy zaaridi ne giddon poo7enna. Macho ekeysinne azina geliyari qaali hizape guye ne giddon si7etenna. Ne zal7anchoti biitta ubban eretida wolqaamata. Ne bitan kawotethata ubbaa cimmadasa” yaagis.
Nabeta suuthay, geeshshata suuthaynne biitta bolla hayqida asa ubbaa suuthay I giddon bentida gisho Babilooney pirdetasu.
